search_text: published ZDI-08-042 ZDI-CAN-315 Sun Java Web Start Sandbox Bypass Vulnerability 2008-07-17 CVE-2008-3112 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2008-3112 ['Sun Microsystems'] ['Java Runtime'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Sun Java Web Start. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the writeManifest() method of the CacheEntry class. A directory traversal flaw in this method allows the creation of arbitrary files on the target system. After the file has been created, a call to Runtime.getRuntime.exec() can be used to execute the file. Sun Microsystems has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Sun Java Web Start Sandbox Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Sun Java Web Start. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the writeManifest() method of the CacheEntry class. A directory traversal flaw in this method allows the creation of arbitrary files on the target system. After the file has been created, a call to Runtime.getRuntime.exec() can be used to execute the file.
